headline: Product Designer | User-Centric Design & Figma Expertise
summary: Dedicated Product Designer with a strong foundation in mathematics and a passion for creating user-centered experiences. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and impactful product solutions. Skilled in utilizing Figma and design systems to ensure consistency and usability. Eager to contribute to a dynamic and forward-thinking company.

bullets: Collaborated with the UX/UI team to design and develop a new mobile application, resulting in a 25% increase in user engagement within the first three months.
Conducted user research and usability testing to identify pain points and optimize the user experience, leading to a 15% reduction in customer support tickets.
Developed and maintained a comprehensive design system, ensuring consistency and scalability across all product touchpoints.
Presented design concepts and prototypes to stakeholders, effectively communicating design rationale and user insights.

education.detail: Graduated with honors, demonstrating a strong foundation in analytical and problem-solving skills.
